# Retinal geometry fixture

`retinal-uv.npz` contains only the actual retained receptor UV coordinates.
It makes the geometry test usable on a fresh clone without downloading the
whole graph. It has no connectivity or neural weights and cannot run a brain.

The array is copied without alteration from the MaleCNS-derived graph:

- Complete graph SHA-256: `8b6a70780c1cb042e87a839b6beed36ca8c4681b1ec5643be14d6b26df18989f`
- UV array SHA-256: `51f7dafd4355a06176418e22373ffcdf5bc066f75050da6dcbaaaccbad55a714`
